description: §14.8.9 — the legitimate path to compute with a protected column: declassify it with `reveal("pin")`, then do arithmetic. No E-PROTECT-006; RUNTIME: the computed value reaches the client (@total = 3 × pin).
rationale: RULING (bryan, S441, verbatim): "ratify with the changes, arithmetic stays protected". `reveal("col")` is the sole declassification path (§14.8.9); reading a revealed column off the revealed value is a declassified read, and arithmetic on it ships. Arithmetic on an UNrevealed column is arithmetic-e006.
